usual_baseline: Doses and level timing are mostly right: correct starting dose 100% [2948][2958], levels at correct time 87–90%. Levels are often out of range: first levels in range 7–33% [2972][2948][2988]. Abnormal levels are not always acted on: 3 of 4 low levels ignored [2958].
fix_that_works: Continuous infusion in neonates: levels in range 28% to 62% [2956]. New paediatric guideline with pharmacist input: in range at 48 hours 7% to 40%; out-of-range levels reviewed 40%, 80% with pharmacist [2972].
fix_that_fails: Electronic prescribing templates and recirculated guideline improved dose frequency (75.9% to 92.6%) but therapeutic first concentration fell from 24.1% to 19.2% [2988]. Still over 80% not in range.
consultant_advice: Prescribing compliance is not the problem. The dosing regimen itself often misses range. Audit first-level attainment and the response to out-of-range levels, and test continuous infusion or pharmacist-led adjustment.
